newsitem.title: TUNISIA: France gives Tunisia a 80 mln francs credit.
newsitem.headline: France gives Tunisia a 80 mln francs credit.

text.p: France will give Tunisia a 80 million French francs credit to modernise infrastructures in poor districts of Tunisian cities, officials said on Wednesday.

The accord was signed on Tuesday in Tunis by Tunisian Minister for International Cooperation and Foreign Investment Mohamed Ghannouchi and Francois Gada, representative in Tunis of France's Caisse Francaise de Development, a state-agency for chanelling credits for cooperation.
